name: sugarcraft/candy-msteams
description: Microsoft Teams channel bundle for candy-code serve: dialogs from Teams personal chats, group chats, and channel posts into a served session - webhook inbound with in-bundle Bot Framework JWT validation, activity-referenced REST outbound, pairing gates, group allowlists, queue modes, chunked redacted replies, adaptive-card approvals with a same-chat text fallback. Policy in the user-tier channels.msteams settings; credentials only in the 0600 channels store. Graph/RSC media and file consent are deferred to P3.5.
